{"query":"query selectComponentFullDataQuery{
  components (
    uuidComponentSearch: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {
    uuid
    name
    uuidUser
    comment
    uuidComponentParent
    idActualStatus
    valueActualStatus
    idComponentType
    valueComponentType
    isDelete
    idTypeAccess
    valueTypeAccess
    commentchange
    isStandard
    createdAt
  }
  
  paramComponent (
    uuidComponentSearch: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {
    id
    uuid
    idParam
    value
  }
  
  files (
    uuidComponentSearch: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {
    uuid
    uuidFileParent
    uuidUserCreate
    filename
    idExt
    valueExt
    createdAt
    filesize
    pathFile
  }
  
  componentModification (
    uuidComponentSearch: "a5953fd9-7393-4f1e-a899-06b5e159dbf1"
  ) {    
    uuid
    uuidComponent
    modificationName
    createdAt
    idNameCad
    valueNameCad
    comment
    uuidModificationParent
    commentchange
    idActualStatus
    valueActualStatus
    isDelete
  }
  
  paramModification (
    uuidModificationSearch: "aba22d59-4f6c-44a4-9a37-2d38f0e577a8"
  ) {
    id
    uuid
    idParam
    value
  }
}
","operationName":"selectComponentFullDataQuery"}
